title: Product Owner
description:
Product Owner 
 BASIC SUMMARY: 
We are seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused Product Owner to support the delivery 
of features and enhancements within our healthcare claims administration platform. This role is 
responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories 
and working closely with engineering teams to ensure timely, high-quality delivery. The ideal 
candidate brings healthcare domain knowledge, understands Agile processes, and is 
comfortable using AI-enabled tools to support requirements definition and backlog 
management. 
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 
Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution 
• Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring stories are well-defined, prioritized, and 
aligned with sprint goals 
• Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and customer- 
centric 
• Conduct regular backlog grooming and sprint planning in collaboration with the Scrum 
team 
• Participate in daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team 
member 
• Ensure user stories meet the definition of ready and done before development and 
release 
Requirements Gathering & User Story Development 
• Collaborate with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to gather and 
refine product requirements 
• Use AI tools (where applicable) to support the creation of epics, themes, and user 
stories 
• Conduct gap analysis and validation of requirements to ensure completeness and 
feasibility 
• Support refinement of use cases, workflows, and functional documentation 
Cross-Functional Collaboration 
• Serve as the primary point of contact for development teams during sprint execution 
• Partner with UX/UI designers to ensure user stories are aligned with design 
principles and usability goals 
• Support QA teams by clarifying acceptance criteria and reviewing test cases as 
needed• Coordinate with other Product Owners to manage interdependencies between 
features 
Customer & Stakeholder Engagement 
• Participate in stakeholder meetings to capture feature requests, enhancement ideas, 
and feedback 
• Communicate updates to internal stakeholders on backlog priorities, delivery timelines, 
and sprint progress 
• Help ensure features delivered meet customer needs and stakeholder expectations 
Healthcare Domain Support 
• Apply working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, billing terminology, and 
reimbursement processes 
• Support compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) in collaboration with 
internal teams 
• Assist in translating complex healthcare requirements into understandable product 
features 
 MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 
• Bachelors degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a 
related field 
• 2+ years of product management experience; healthcare technology or claims 
administration preferred 
• 2+ years of experience working with AI tools for product development, requirements 
engineering, or business analysis preferred 
• Familiarity with Agile software development and Scrum methodology 
• Proficiency with Jira (or similar Agile tools) for backlog management 
• Experience using AI-assisted tools to help structure requirements and analyze user input 
(preferred but not required) 
• Basic understanding of software development processes and technical constraints 
• Familiarity with collaboration tools (e.g., Confluence, Miro, Figma) 
• Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying requirements and 
feedback 
• High attention to detail and organizational skills 
• Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment 
• Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and resolving blockers quickly 
Preferred Qualifications 
• Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification 
• Understanding of healthcare data standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, X12 EDI) Mandatory Healthcare experience

Key Skills: Product Life Cycle,Product Strategy,Product Roadmap,Product Analysis,Safe,Life cycle,Analysis,Roadmap

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Job Description: 
 Title: Business Development Manager - IT Staffing & Technology Solutions 
Location: Bangalore/ Hyderabad 
Experience: 8+ Years 
 Job Type : Full-time
 About MSH: 
MSH is a global consulting firm. Our consultative recruiting and talent acquisition services help clients around the world align their people, processes, and technology with overall business objectives. Headquartered in Ft Lauderdale, Florida and founded in 2011, we have operations across US, Canada, LATAM and India with more than 150 Fortune 500 customers. We are ISO 27001 and SSAE16 SOC1 & SOC2 compliant company.
Our technology platform coupled with our best-in-class SPM Methodology helps to deliver transformative talent solutions to clients across the globe. Our cloud-native platform Aeon takes HR tech to the next level by leveraging the power of todays AI, machine learning, and predictive models to create an unmatched digital experience in the talent ecosystem. Our vision is to build next-generation Talent Solutions that accelerate the journey from sourcing to hiring.
Visit us @: www.talentmsh.com 
 
 Description: 
We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to drive domestic and international sales and business growth across Technology Staffing, Professional Search, Talent Solutions and GCC setup services .
The ideal candidate will have strong experience in B2B technology sales , preferably from an IT staffing, recruitment, technology consulting or talent solutions organization , with a proven track record of acquiring new clients, generating business through cold calling, conducting client meetings and delivering business presentations.
This role will focus on identifying and engaging technology organizations, GCCs and enterprises in India, understanding their talent and technology requirements, and positioning our staffing and talent solutions to support their growth.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Business Development & New Client Acquisition 
 Identify and develop new business opportunities across the domestic & international technology market . Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients across IT, technology services, product companies, GCCs and emerging technology organizations. Conduct cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting and other outbound sales activities to generate qualified leads. Research target organizations, decision-makers and business requirements to identify potential opportunities. Build relationships with CHROs, HR Heads, Talent Acquisition Heads, Procurement Heads, Business Leaders, CTOs and GCC leaders . Own the complete business development cycle from lead generation and qualification through meetings, proposal, negotiation and closure. 
 Staffing & Talent Solutions Sales 
 Drive sales for: IT Staffing & Contract Staffing Permanent / Full-Time Hiring Professional Search & Executive Search Technology Talent Solutions Recruitment Process / Talent Acquisition Solutions Understand client workforce requirements and recommend appropriate talent engagement models. Partner with internal recruitment and delivery teams to ensure smooth execution of client requirements. Identify opportunities for account expansion, cross-selling and repeat business. 
 GCC Business Development 
 Identify organizations planning to establish, expand or scale their GCC / offshore operations in India . Position talent and professional search solutions to support GCC setup and scale-up requirements. Engage with GCC leadership and business stakeholders to understand hiring plans, technology functions and workforce requirements. Develop relationships with organizations looking to build technology teams in India. Support the sales process for GCC talent acquisition, professional search and workforce solutions . 
 Client Meetings & Presentations 
 Schedule and conduct B2B client meetings and discovery calls . Present company capabilities, staffing solutions, talent services and GCC solutions to prospective clients. Prepare customized proposals, presentations and commercial responses based on client requirements. Participate in negotiations and commercial discussions to successfully close business. 
 Account & Relationship Management 
 Develop long-term relationships with existing and prospective technology clients. Understand changing client workforce requirements and identify new business opportunities. Maintain accurate sales pipeline, opportunity tracking and forecasting. Work closely with delivery, recruitment and leadership teams to ensure client satisfaction and successful account growth. 
 Required Skills & Experience 
8+ years of experience in Business Development / Sales 
Proven experience in B2B technology client acquisition .
Hands-on experience with cold calling and outbound sales . Strong experience in conducting client meetings, discovery discussions, and business presentations .
Demonstrated ability to independently generate leads and build a sales pipeline. Experience selling to technology companies, enterprises, GCCs, or IT services organizations .
Strong understanding of the IT hiring/staffing ecosystem.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Ability to engage confidently with senior decision-makers and business stakeholders .
Strong commercial orientation with a focus on revenue generation and business closure.
Willingness to travel for client meetings when required.
 
 Education and Experience: 
 A strong work ethic and sense of commitment History of exceeding personal goals while working in a team environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ATS knowledge. Able to work in a very fast-paced, dynamic environment. Experience handling both Indian and international markets Closing skills and the ability to build lasting relationships built on honesty and integrity. Certifications in Leadership or Project Management are a plus. A bachelor's degree is preferred.

Key Skills: New Client Acquisition,Lead Generation,IT Business Development,Client Acquisition,Corporate Business Development,Business Development Management,New Business Acquisition,Business Management
